content.value: Find the conditions on 11. and $\mu$ so that the following system oflinear equations will have (i) a (12) unique solution, (ii) no solution and (iii) many solutions.

$$
2 x + 3 y + z = 5 ; \qquad 3 x - y + \lambda z = 2 ; \qquad x + 7 y - 6 z = \mu
$$
